channel.title: Linear Algebra Elective :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Linear algebra provides the mathematical foundations for large-scale data processing, large-language models, neural networks, computer graphics, computational statistics, and many other computational techniques. Thus, every computer science student should have a solid grounding in linear algebra and is required to take one of the following courses: MATH 515 - Introduction to Linear Algebra This course has a prerequisite of Calculus II MATH 551 - Applied Matrix Theory This course has a prerequisite of Calculus II MATH 350 - Mathematical Scholars Calculus III This course is part of the Mathematical Scholars program in Mathematics and only open to students in the program.
